parameters.query: =INSERT INTO user_feedback (signal_id, decision, channel, decided_via) VALUES ('{{ $json.signal_id }}','{{ $json.decision }}','telegram','button') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; UPDATE signals SET status='{{ {"INVESTIGATE":"INVESTIGATING","WATCH":"WATCHING","DISMISS":"DISMISSED","CONFIRM":"CONFIRMED","REMIND":"REMINDER_SET"}[$json.decision] || "WATCHING" }}' WHERE signal_id='{{ $json.signal_id }}'; INSERT INTO actions (signal_id,action_type,payload,status) VALUES ('{{ $json.signal_id }}','user_decision','{"via":"telegram"}'::jsonb,'done');

=SELECT c.statement, c.actor, c.action, s.publisher, s.source_url FROM claims c LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.signal_id='{{ $json.signal_id }}' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
